Two more instances of the #8691/#8744 silent no-op class — a declared component key with no props row is exactly the declared≠enforced shape the roster exists to prevent. Known pits recorded now for the eventual dispatch (deferral is not shelving):

1. The exact-set assert in `packages/cloud-connection/src/canonical-expression-envelopes.test.ts` (PR #11574) will DEMAND the two exemptions + emptiness pins be deleted in the same PR that adds the props-map rows — plan the diff to include it.
2. Key sets must be measured from the renderers' ACTUAL read points at the pinned `.objectui-sha`, never from registration declarations (#8691/#8744 both record where those diverge).
3. Re-verify the premise on the post-#11289 merged ref before dispatch (standard unlock discipline) — both cards edit the same file and #11289 may shift anchors.
